Starting Balances — Investments

The Starting Balances screen allows you to set up starting balances for the investments you have created under the Investments tab. This is useful when you are starting to use Manager and need to input the existing balances of your investments.

To create a new starting balance for an investment, click the New Starting Balance button.

InvestmentsNewStartingBalance

You will be taken to the Starting Balance screen for the investment. For more information on how to complete this form, see Starting Balance for Investment Form.
